title: River of Swamps Boat Tours
specs: Explore largest contiguous forested wetland in North America, the Atchafalaya Basin
See wild alligators in natural habitat; no feeding wildlife
Quiet flatbottom boat allows close viewing of birds and wildlife
No stated age minimum; kids under 13 or 12 pay reduced price
Boat fitted with 6 chairs for guests
Swamp Tour and Cajun Lunch up to 6 passengers

options.name: Customized Bayou Boat Tour
options.detail: Custom tours of the swamp for special occasions or unique requests

services.name: Customized Bayou Boat Tour
services.desc: We offer custom tours of the swamp for special occasions or unique requests. Contact Ronnie with your request, we'll try to put together an amazing bayou

variants.label: Custom tours of the swamp for special occasions or unique requests

includes: Authentic Cajun lunch with shrimp, catfish, crawfish or alligator, Po-boy sandwich, fish tacos, fish patties, desserts and cold drinks
Guide is USCG licensed captain with safety and first aid training
blurb: Guests take private boat tours through Louisiana swamps, exploring the Atchafalaya Basin and other local bayous. Tours include wildlife viewing, cultural experiences, and optional Cajun lunch. The guide is a licensed USCG captain with local knowledge and fishing experience.
extraNote: $50 deposit per group required after booking request approval for Bayou Benoit tour · Tickets can be paid online or in person; cash or card accepted · 48 hour notice required to schedule Swamp Tour and Cajun Lunch · Bayou Benoit boat landing near Lake Fausse Point State Park or Atchafalaya Welcome Center at Butte La Rose off I-10 exit 121
